stylographs.m: More than one stylograph. stylograph: a fountain pen that has a thin hollow tube or needle instead of a nib, and which releases ink when pressed against the paper.

stylography.m: The process of drawing or writing using a stylus onto a wax tablet, etc.

stylolite.m: An irregular surface between strata consisting of toothlike projections.

stylolites.m: More than one stylolite. stylolite: an irregular surface between strata consisting of toothlike projections.

stypticity.m: The quality or state of being styptic.
